title: Psychobiology
description: For projects centered on behavior and its biological bases, including learning and memory, sleep, exercise, and systems neuroscience.

title: Physiological Sciences
description: For projects focused on physiological mechanisms, including exercise physiology, neurophysiology, and integrated experimental approaches.

label: Psychobiology
title: Behavior and brain
description: Develop a project linking exercise, behavior, cognition, sleep, or neural activity through the Graduate Program in Psychobiology.

label: Physiological Sciences
title: Mechanisms and function
description: Investigate exercise and physiological function through the Multicenter Graduate Program in Physiological Sciences.

label: Scientific initiation
title: Join an active project
description: Learn how a research question becomes an experiment and gain supervised experience in literature review, laboratory routines, data organization, and analysis.

label: Research training
title: Build practical skills
description: Develop a foundation in reproducible workflows, scientific programming, behavioral methods, electrophysiology, and research communication according to project needs.

title: Multimodal treadmill
description: A research platform for controlled locomotion and behavioral paradigms, designed to support multimodal experimental protocols.

title: Electrophysiology workflows
description: Collaborative support for neural-signal experiments, from study planning and acquisition workflows to quality control and analysis.

title: Software and analysis
description: Open and reproducible tools for behavioral data, electrophysiological signals, artifact rejection, visualization, and research workflows.
